scope: Full 3D Coulomb gpu_prepare_constraints with fresh and recycled points, nearest cached impulse transfer, scaled masses and body-tagged warmstart cache
tolerance_reason: Same f32 limits as existing contact kernels; copied fields, IDs, zero padding, cached impulse selection and inactive storage are exact.
preconditions: Rust-derived 3D Coulomb ABI, finite data, unit rotations and orthonormal contact frames
Valid active contact/body/previous indices; link bodies agree with manifold bodies
Recycled links identify a previous constraint; input and output allocations are disjoint
Output lanes are independent; input body and velocity indices MAY be shared
The native ContactPlan bound is supplied in device storage and does not exceed the declared launch capacity; standalone fixtures declare its live count.
invariants: Readonly inputs and inactive tile lanes/points unchanged
Copied distances, impulse selections, body IDs, split velocity slot IDs and warmstart tags remain exact
Every contact invocation reads the device plan bound before dereferencing contact or body storage; padded invocations preserve every guard word.
outside_scope: Link creation, sorting and recycle eligibility
Shared body warmstart gather and production solver schedule
